title: Timezone Mismatch
description: Stops travellers misreading every time by hours: when the device's time zone differs from the account's, it shows both clocks ticking side by side, asks once whether to use the device zone, confirms the answer without losing focus and remembers it per pair of zones, comparing every real clock change from the tz database so zones that only drift apart for a few days (Jerusalem and Athens) still count as different.
stops: Misread every time by hours while travelling
